== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Endross]] [[Travelers]] are a group of individuals associated with the [[Territory]] of [[Endross]]. They are characterized by their ability to summon and manipulate powerful elemental forces, specifically white lightning bolts and massive storm-like [[Gates]] that can grow large enough to shroud entire areas in dark clouds. These [[Travelers]] are often seen working alongside troops or other groups of [[Travelers]], such as those from [[Naraka]]. Historically, they were noted for helping to maintain their territories by managing wild elements and overseeing infrastructure like roads and waystations, though they eventually became known for their aggressive behavior. The [[Endross]] group is also linked to the presence of an [[Incarnation]], a powerful entity that behaves like a natural disaster and possesses physical traits such as wings made of stormclouds and eyes that glow with lightning. While some describe their methods as unsophisticated, focusing primarily on attacking targets, they are a significant force capable of traveling through [[Gates]] to move between territories.}}
